faq.q: What is the weather like in Marbella in December 2046?
faq.a: December in Marbella is mild and pleasant, with average daytime highs of 19°C and lows around 16°C. Sea temperatures hover between 16°C and 18°C. You can expect around 8 hours of sunshine daily, with occasional light rain (average 5-7 rainy days). Winds are typically light (5-15 knots), making for calm boating conditions.

faq.q: Can I rent a boat in Marbella in December 2046?
faq.a: Yes, absolutely. Our entire fleet is available year-round. All boats depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. December offers quieter marinas and more availability. Popular choices are the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 from €749 for 2 hours.

faq.q: Are the boats heated in winter?
faq.a: Yes, most of our larger yachts (e.g., Azimut 58 Flybridge, Ferretti 94, Mangusta 80) have enclosed saloons with heating. On cooler days, you can enjoy the comfort of a warm interior while still taking in the views. Smaller open boats like the Speedboat or Mariah SX21 are best for sunny afternoons.

faq.q: What should I wear for a December boat trip in Marbella?
faq.a: Layers are key. A light jacket or fleece, long trousers, and comfortable shoes are recommended. The sun can still be strong, so bring sunglasses and sunscreen. If you plan to sit on deck, a windproof jacket helps. The skipper will ensure you're comfortable.

faq.q: Which destinations are best for a December boat charter?
faq.a: Popular winter routes include cruising along the Golden Mile to see Marbella's coastline, visiting the Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for a quiet anchorage, or heading west towards Estepona. The sea is usually calm, so longer trips to Sotogrande are also feasible with larger yachts.

faq.q: How much does a boat rental cost in December 2046?
faq.a: Prices are the same year-round. The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 start at €749 for 2 hours, up to €2,299 for 8 hours. The Mangusta 80 (white or grey) is €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. For other boats, pricing is available on request via WhatsApp.

faq.q: Do I need to book in advance for December?
faq.a: While December is less busy than summer, we recommend booking at least a week in advance to secure your preferred yacht and time slot. Last-minute bookings are sometimes possible—contact us via WhatsApp to check availability.

faq.q: What is included in the December charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). There are no hidden fees. You just need to bring yourself and your group.

data.body_html:
Thinking of a December boat rental Marbella 2046 weather escape? You're in luck—Marbella's winter is mild, with average highs of 19°C, sea temperatures around 16-18°C, and around 8 hours of daily sunshine. The Mediterranean stays calm, winds are light (5-15 knots), and the marinas are quieter than in summer. Whether you want a cosy afternoon cruise along the Golden Mile or a longer trip to Estepona, our fleet of luxury yachts from Puerto Banús is ready for you. All charters include a skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT—just show up.

December Weather in Marbella: What to Expect

December in Marbella is one of the sunniest winter destinations in Europe. Daytime temperatures typically range from 16°C to 19°C, with sea temperatures between 16°C and 18°C. You'll enjoy around 8 hours of sunshine daily, with only 5-7 rainy days on average. The wind is usually light (5-15 knots), creating calm seas perfect for boating. The backdrop of the snow-capped Sierra Blanca and La Concha mountain adds a stunning contrast to the blue sea.

Best Boats for a December Charter

For cooler days, enclosed flybridge yachts like the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) or the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) offer heated saloons. For a more budget-friendly option, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are available from €749 for 2 hours (€2,299 for 8 hours), including skipper and all drinks. If you want extra fun, the Mangusta 80 (white or grey, 24m, 12 pax) includes a free jet ski from €4,719 for 4 hours. For smaller groups, the Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are perfect for sunny afternoons.

Suggested December Itineraries

  • Golden Mile Cruise (2-3 hours): Depart Puerto Banús, sail past the luxury hotels and villas of Marbella's Golden Mile, anchor near Cala del Faro for a drink.
  • Estepona Escape (4-6 hours): Head west to Estepona, enjoy the coastal views, and stop at Cala Cortés for a swim (water temp ~17°C).
  • Sotogrande Lunch Run (6-8 hours): Cruise to Sotogrande marina for a long lunch at a beachfront chiringuito, then return via the coast.

What's Included in Every Charter

All our charters are all-inclusive. You get a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden extras. Just bring your group and enjoy.

How to Book Your December Boat Rental

Booking is simple. For our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), you can book directly at the rates above. For the Mangusta 80, the minimum is 4 hours at €4,719. For all other boats (e.g., Pershing 46, Fairline Targa, Maiora 26m), pricing is on request via WhatsApp. We recommend booking at least a week ahead for December to secure your preferred slot. Explore our full fleet here.

Why Rent a Boat in Marbella in December?

December offers a unique perspective: fewer crowds, lower prices (same rates as summer but more availability), and the chance to see Marbella's coastline in a different light. The sea is calm, the sun is warm enough for a deck chair, and the marinas are lively but not packed. Plus, you can combine your boat trip with a visit to Puerto Banús for Christmas lights and shopping.
